about: Hand-picked swaps: a cheaper tool that does the same core job. Shown in My Stack only when the swap's listed price is below what the user pays. Always caveated: check the features you rely on before switching.

mailchimp: Free up to 1,000 subscribers, with campaigns and automations included
Priced by emails sent, not contacts, which suits big lists you email rarely
activecampaign: Email, SMS and a basic CRM, priced by emails sent
Automations and landing pages on a free or low-cost plan
klaviyo: Covers the basics for small shops without per-profile pricing jumps
flodesk: Good-looking templates plus a free plan
beehiiv: Creator newsletters with paid subscriptions built in
constant-contact: Similar campaign tools at a lower entry price
semrush: Rank tracking, site audits and keyword research for less
ahrefs: Backlink monitoring and rank tracking at a lower price
clearscope: On-page content optimization at a lower price
jasper-ai: General AI assistants now handle most marketing copy
Strong long-form writing and brand-voice editing
writesonic: Covers most blog and ad-copy drafting
writer: Long-form drafting and editing for a single seat
sprout-social: Scheduling and basic analytics, free to start
Multi-network scheduling with a free tier
hootsuite: Simple scheduling with a free tier
Bulk scheduling with a free tier
later: Instagram and TikTok scheduling, free to start
contentstudio: Scheduling and recycling posts with a free tier
upfluence: Influencer search and outreach for a fraction of the price
zapier: Visual multi-step automations with more operations per dollar
kajabi: Course builder with a free plan and no transaction fees
Courses, funnels and email, free to start
teachable: Course builder with a free plan
Courses plus funnels and email in one
bigcommerce: A free plugin if you already run WordPress (hosting is extra)
shopify: A free plugin if you already run WordPress (hosting is extra)
deepbrain-ai: AI avatar videos at a lower entry price
descript: Free editor with auto-captions for social clips
opusclip: Free editor for cutting and captioning clips
runway: Cinematic camera-motion presets at a lower entry price
invideo-ai: Script-to-video at a lower entry price
asana: Simple boards for small teams, free to start
Docs, tasks and goals in one place, free to start
monday-com: Similar views and automations, free to start
airtable: Databases and docs together, free for individuals
typeform: Free unlimited forms that feed straight into Sheets
salesforce: Pipeline-first CRM built for small sales teams
A full CRM at a small-business price
intercom: Live chat plus an AI chatbot for small sites
Ticketing and help desk, free to start
zendesk: Help desk with a free tier
quickbooks: Free invoicing and accounting (payments cost extra)
grok: Cheaper paid tier with a broader feature set
Strong writing and analysis on the $17-$20 tier
adobe-firefly: AI image generation with a free tier
zoom: Video meetings, calling and messaging in one app
Video meetings and team chat; included with many Microsoft 365 business plans
Google Meet video calls come with Workspace business plans
slack: Team chat and meetings; included with many Microsoft 365 business plans
Google Chat comes with Workspace business plans
